site_recommendation.material: 灰黄褐砖面与灰褐叠涩檐、较深券洞；现代文字不复制，底部实体浅砖保留。
site_recommendation.lineDetail: Portrait 1024x1536. JINGYANG Shaanxi Chongwen pagoda, NOT the similarly named Jianshui Yunnan tower. Exactly THIRTEEN octagonal brick storeys tapering upward, tall ground storey with its layered eave treatment, alternating arched openings/niches. Preserve the present blunt flat upper termination in the photograph; no invented copper gourd or tall spire. Include entire base.
site_recommendation.lede: 八角砖身高高叠起，塔檐向上逐级收束。崇文塔立在泾阳，明代营建记录与今日的砖塔现貌在这里相遇。
facts: 营建 采用碑记所述1591—1608年，历年介绍有不同纪年，来源记录保留差异。
形制 八角十三层楼阁式砖塔，券门与龛口随层次安排。
图版范围 仅绘塔体与台基，现存截顶按照片保留，不复原早期塔刹。
